summary.headline: Ascensions, Melothesia, and Configurations
summary.text: Discussion of planetary fortune according to benefic or malefic houses and terms, followed by sections on the ascensions of the seven climates, the melothesia of the signs, and trines, squares, diameters, and unconnected configurations. Ptolemy, the Egyptians, Valens, and Porphyry are cited.
